title: Are Two LLMs Better Than One? A Student-Teacher Dual-Head LLMs Architecture for Pharmaceutical Content Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2602.11957v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used for content creation in regulated domains such as pharmaceuticals, where content must be medical accurate and legally compliant. Traditional manual quality control (QC) is slow, error-prone, and create publication bottlenecks. To address this, we introduce a modular, LLM/VLMs-driven QC architecture, LRBTC (Language, Regulatory, Brand, Technical, Content Structure), implemented through a Student Teacher HITL architecture and Waterfall rule filtering logic for scalable, verifiable content validation. This architecture is designed to provide verifiable, traceable, and scalable content optimization. Our methods achieve 83.0% F1 and 97.5% recall on AIReg Bench, reducing missed violations five fold compared with Gemini 2.5 Pro. On CSpelling, it improves mean accuracy by +26.7 %. Our error analysis further reveals that while current models are strong at detecting misspellings (92.5% recall)

translated_title: 两个大语言模型比一个好吗？一种用于制药内容优化的师生双头大语言模型架构
translated_abstract: 大语言模型越来越多地被应用于制药等受监管领域的内容创作，在这些领域中，内容必须达到医学准确性和法律合规性。传统的人工质量控制（QC）速度慢、易出错，并造成发布瓶颈。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种模块化、由LLM/VLM驱动的QC架构——LRBTC（语言、法规、品牌、技术、内容结构），通过师生人机协同架构和瀑布式规则过滤逻辑实现可扩展、可验证的内容审核。该架构旨在提供可验证、可追溯、可扩展的内容优化。我们的方法在AIReg Bench上实现了83.0%的F1分数和97.5%的召回率，与Gemini 2.5 Pro相比将漏检违规减少了五倍。在CSpelling数据集上，平均准确率提升了26.7%。我们的误差分析进一步揭示，尽管当前模型在检测拼写错误方面表现较强（92.5%的召回率）
tldr: 本文提出面向制药合规内容审核的LRBTC架构，采用师生双头LLM/VLM结合瀑布式规则过滤逻辑，在AIReg Bench上达到83.0% F1与97.5%召回率，漏检违规较Gemini 2.5 Pro减少五倍。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces LRBTC, a student-teacher dual-head LLM/VLM quality-control architecture with waterfall rule filtering for pharmaceutical content compliance, achieving 83.0% F1 and 97.5% recall on AIReg Bench and reducing missed violations five-fold compared with Gemini 2.5 Pro.
